## Checked

- [ ] `npm run check` (typecheck, lint, unit tests) passes
- [ ] `npm run e2e` passes, with a test for the change where it makes sense
- [ ] UI changes: tried on a phone or in the browser at phone size; screenshots attached
- [ ] Android changes: built (`./gradlew assembleDebug`) and tried on a device or emulator
- [ ] No "YouTube Music" in visible UI text; the Jukebox stays the centrepiece

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the build and commit style.
